correctness.rationale: The extension property and homogeneity make the ideal/filter pairs exactly the named nonalgebraic one-types. If both sets are nonempty, height two forces them onto opposite levels and accounts for B, giving t=2|J|-1+B. In the ideal transfer matrix T=[[1,1],[1,2]], holding x_0=0 and x_k=x_{k+1}=1 changes just the weight on the chorded edge from two to one, leaving two off-diagonal entries of powers of T. The even Lucas product identity makes that deficit strictly increase in the shorter arc coordinate, and the B correction is nonincreasing. The unique edge between the two degree-three endpoints identifies the chord up to its recovered cycle distances. With a_0 excluded for the two-chord pair, severing either pair of path weights leaves two free singletons and a path on n-3 variables; with a_0 included the contribution is (T^n)_{11}, using zero-based matrix labels. In both cases the first and second chords increase B by 8 and 12 respectively; the two degree-three maxima distinguish the structures by two versus one common lower neighbor even at n=5. The n=4 witnesses have respectively three versus two common upper neighbors of the two degree-three minima. At n=3 the two-element chord subsets are all in a single rotation orbit. Independent explicit transitivity testing gives the (empty/empty, empty/nonempty, nonempty/empty, nonempty/nonempty) counts (1,40,40,34) for both n=4 witnesses and (1,108,108,40) for both n=5 witnesses; replay with `python /workspace/replay_frozen_reviews.py 4`. The checks at finite n corroborate, but do not replace, the all-n argument.
